offset: (variable.u.x * math.cos((variable.a0 + (variable.a1 - variable.a0) * variable.particle_random_1)) + variable.v.x * math.sin((variable.a0 + (variable.a1 - variable.a0) * variable.particle_random_1))) * (variable.r - variable.thick * variable.particle_random_2 * math.pow(1 - variable.particle_random_1, 0.6) * math.sin(math.min(1, variable.particle_random_1 * 6) * 90)) + variable.w.x * (variable.particle_random_3 - 0.5) * 0.15

(variable.u.y * math.cos((variable.a0 + (variable.a1 - variable.a0) * variable.particle_random_1)) + variable.v.y * math.sin((variable.a0 + (variable.a1 - variable.a0) * variable.particle_random_1))) * (variable.r - variable.thick * variable.particle_random_2 * math.pow(1 - variable.particle_random_1, 0.6) * math.sin(math.min(1, variable.particle_random_1 * 6) * 90)) + variable.w.y * (variable.particle_random_3 - 0.5) * 0.15

(variable.u.z * math.cos((variable.a0 + (variable.a1 - variable.a0) * variable.particle_random_1)) + variable.v.z * math.sin((variable.a0 + (variable.a1 - variable.a0) * variable.particle_random_1))) * (variable.r - variable.thick * variable.particle_random_2 * math.pow(1 - variable.particle_random_1, 0.6) * math.sin(math.min(1, variable.particle_random_1 * 6) * 90)) + variable.w.z * (variable.particle_random_3 - 0.5) * 0.15
direction: (variable.u.x * math.sin((variable.a0 + (variable.a1 - variable.a0) * variable.particle_random_1)) - variable.v.x * math.cos((variable.a0 + (variable.a1 - variable.a0) * variable.particle_random_1))) * (variable.a1 > variable.a0 ? 1 : -1)

(variable.u.y * math.sin((variable.a0 + (variable.a1 - variable.a0) * variable.particle_random_1)) - variable.v.y * math.cos((variable.a0 + (variable.a1 - variable.a0) * variable.particle_random_1))) * (variable.a1 > variable.a0 ? 1 : -1)

(variable.u.z * math.sin((variable.a0 + (variable.a1 - variable.a0) * variable.particle_random_1)) - variable.v.z * math.cos((variable.a0 + (variable.a1 - variable.a0) * variable.particle_random_1))) * (variable.a1 > variable.a0 ? 1 : -1)

size: variable.particle_age < (variable.particle_random_1 * variable.dur) ? 0 : variable.size * (0.09 + math.pow(1 - variable.particle_random_1, 0.6) * math.sin(math.min(1, variable.particle_random_1 * 6) * 90) * 0.14) * (1 - math.clamp((variable.particle_age - (variable.particle_random_1 * variable.dur)) / variable.life, 0, 1) * 0.85)

variable.particle_age < (variable.particle_random_1 * variable.dur) ? 0 : variable.size * (0.09 + math.pow(1 - variable.particle_random_1, 0.6) * math.sin(math.min(1, variable.particle_random_1 * 6) * 90) * 0.14) * (1 - math.clamp((variable.particle_age - (variable.particle_random_1 * variable.dur)) / variable.life, 0, 1) * 0.85)

color.interpolant: variable.tone > 0.5 ? math.clamp(0.6 + variable.particle_random_2 * 0.3 + math.clamp((variable.particle_age - (variable.particle_random_1 * variable.dur)) / variable.life, 0, 1) * 0.1, 0.6, 1) : math.clamp(variable.particle_random_2 * 0.35 + math.clamp((variable.particle_age - (variable.particle_random_1 * variable.dur)) / variable.life, 0, 1) * 0.2 + variable.tone, 0, 0.55)
